new.s: Under the Prohibition of Child Marriage Act, 2006, the legal status of a child marriage is that it is:
o: Void ab initio in all cases
Voidable at the option of the party who was a minor at the time of marriage
Voidable only at the option of the State Government
new.x: Under PCMA 2006 a child marriage is voidable at the option of the minor party, not automatically void. It is not fully valid and unchallengeable, and the option lies with the minor party, not the State Government.
new.tq: Child marriage = voidable at minor party's option.
